summary: Implements the CryptographicAnchorClassifier certificate detectors; fork adds `paccor diff` to compare two component sets.
Fixes the Sysmon log name, nonexistent .bin names and a LogCheck crash; fork adds CI, a test corpus and a hardened LogCheck.py.
Fixes AppLocker event levels (#19) and the DefenderErr provider name; fork adds consistency tests, modern subscriptions and a Sigma generator.
Assigns unique SIDs so the rule files load; fork adds Suricata 7 and Snort 3 rule sets, tests and CI.
Fixes the default lookback and leftover debug code in the event scripts; fork adds Pester policy tests, tools and a CI workflow.
Fixes Secure Boot signing snippets (#24, #25, #26); fork adds a read-only checker for the 2011 to 2023 Secure Boot CA rollover.
Adds CoRIM with CoSWID system tests; fork adds a Veraison interop harness and workflow.
Adds a GitHub Actions build and self-test workflow; fork adds a JUnit 5 suite with the NIST CAVP Hash_DRBG vectors, a Maven build and a native image.
Removes tcg_rim_tool leftovers after its move to RIM-Tool; fork adds an ML-DSA COSE engine with tests and CI.
Replaces dead links on the open source page; fork adds this generated library page, a link check and Pages publishing.
